claims.text: The woman in the technical jacket rides the dragon into an epic battleground: a cinematic Hollywood scene with dramatic expressions and camera movements.

The woman wears a high-collared black tactical jacket with straps and metal buckle details, a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, black lace-up combat boots, and a metallic tag necklace, with short dark hair shaved at the sides into a small topknot.
The dragon is a large quadrupedal creature with dark, heavily scaled hide, a crest of long backward-swept horns, a spiked ridge along neck and spine, and large membranous wings.

soundscape: Wind rushes hard past the camera, undercut by heavy leathery wingbeats, creaking harness leather, the dragon's low growl, distant fiery explosions and shouts from far below, and the crackle of scattered fires.
music: A full orchestral action score: low brass swells and driving percussion under a rising string ostinato, building through the dive and landing on a heavy timpani and cymbal hit, then thinning to a tense sustained chord.

description.text: A wide, smoke-wreathed battleground opens beneath a bruised, ash-dimmed sky, broken stone and burning wreckage stretching to a hazy horizon.
bursts out of a bank of dark smoke, wings spread wide, black to blue-gray armored scales taking the orange-red glow of distant fires while its long pale-tipped horns sweep back from the skull.
sits astride its back in the black high-collared technical jacket, leaning forward against the wind as the pair clears the smoke into open air.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the mounted pair emerges from the smoke and the burning battlefield is revealed behind them.
Heavy wingbeats and a hard rush of wind fill the air.
Distant explosions thud far across the battleground.
Medium close on

, the camera arcing around her face while the dragon banks beneath her. Wind drags at her short dark hair and the small topknot, strands flattening across her cheek; the thin scar-like mark through one eyebrow catches the firelight as her serious expression hardens into fierce resolve and her eyes drop toward the enemy line far below.
The camera arcs around the subject with small amplitude at slow speed, holding her face against the blurred rush of sky and smoke beyond the harness.
A roaring wall of wind and the creak of strained harness leather.
The dragon growls low beneath her, felt more than heard.
The dive drops into a low, speeding pass:
folds its wings back and skims above the ranks of soldiers, kicking up dust and embers across the broken stone as
leans hard into the plunge and grips the harness straps, teeth set. Ranks scatter below, shields tipping and banners whipping, while firelight smears across the scales.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at fast speed, racing low alongside the diving pair as the ground streaks past.
Rushing wind rises to a roar as the pair drops.
The dragon roars; distant shouts scatter below.
The landing:

slams down into the fray with wings flaring wide, armored scales dark against the blast. A shockwave of dust, embers and shattered stone bursts outward in a ring, torn banners and debris tumbling past the lens while
braces low, one arm across the harness, staring ahead with a fierce expression as smoke rolls around them.
The camera shakes strongly with large amplitude at fast speed on impact, then steadies as the dust ring spreads.
A heavy impact slams through the ground, followed by scattering debris and a roaring dragon.
Fire crackles close by as the dust begins to settle.
